svg.title: BOKI character modeling handoff
svg.text: BOKI / MODELING HANDOFF V2 · PROPOSED ART SPEC
Blender shape reference + editable construction notes / Unity 6000.6.7f1 target
1.85 m neutral height; same rig across
M_MeleeBody: one shared skinned mesh and skeleton.
Izgubljeni meščan: rusty jacket regions; optional
Student: green-gray texture + rigid backpack to
No weapon, separate combat AI or ragdoll is added.
Match bone names and rest pose across all
Keep elbows and knees thick enough for pursuit
Jacket hem can follow pelvis; avoid a cloth
Backpack is rigid and does not need extra deform
Max four bone influences per vertex; keep most
Melee_Contact — short visual hit, damage remains
One animation family reused by all three
Generic rig first for bespoke jam
Socket_HitCenter at chest is a proposed effect marker.
Shared collider and movement root stay outside the model.
Backpack parent: chest; no duplicate skeleton.
Unity +X right / +Y up / +Z forward · meters · all new art sizes and budgets are proposals.
Generated artwork is raster reference; notes/diagrams are editable vectors. Meshes, rigs and integration are future work.
Canonical rules: docs/Story.md + docs/Gameplay.md · practical import and wiring: UNITY_HANDOFF.md
